[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/libbpf.c","function":"bpf_object__init_user_maps","line":1933,"var":"nr_maps","code":"nr_maps++;","note":"Each non-section symbol in the legacy maps section increments the map count derived from attacker-controlled ELF symbols."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/libbpf.c","function":"bpf_object__init_user_maps","line":1939,"var":"data->d_size % nr_maps","code":"if (!data->d_size || nr_maps == 0 || (data->d_size % nr_maps) != 0)","note":"The code checks for zero maps before dividing, so this path is not the crash source; it constrains the legacy-map hypothesis."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/linker.c","function":"linker_sanity_check_elf_symtab","line":775,"var":"sec->shdr->sh_entsize","code":"if (sec->shdr->sh_size % sec->shdr->sh_entsize != 0)","note":"The linker validates symbol-table entry sizing before any division, so malformed SYMTAB sizing is rejected early."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/linker.c","function":"linker_sanity_check_elf_relos","line":849,"var":"sec->shdr->sh_entsize","code":"if (sec->shdr->sh_size % sec->shdr->sh_entsize != 0)","note":"Relocation sections are also guarded against zero or mismatched entry sizes, eliminating this as the vulnerable sink."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/libbpf.c","function":"bpf_object__collect_prog_relos","line":4032,"var":"nrels","code":"nrels = shdr->sh_size / shdr->sh_entsize;","note":"The vulnerable hypothesis is that an attacker-controlled SHT_REL section can set sh_entsize to zero, causing a division-by-zero during relocation collection before per-entry validation runs."}
]
